title: Palm Beach County weekend plans, starting cheap
igCaption:
Palm Beach County weekend plans, starting with the cheap one.

Sources: Secret Miami, Miami New Times, Sun Sentinel, Markets of Tomorrow, WPTV, The Boca Raton Tribune

#PalmBeachCounty #WestPalmBeach #BocaRaton #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: Need Palm Beach County weekend plans? Start with the twenty-eight dollar train deal, then plan the rest of the day.

Amtrak has Winter Wanderlust fares as low as twenty-eight dollars each way from Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa. Book by November twelfth. Travel runs from December first through March fourteenth, with blackout dates from December eighteenth to January third and February twelfth to fifteenth.
scenes.caption: Amtrak has Winter Wanderlust fares as low as $28 each way from Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa. Book by Nov. 12. Travel runs from Dec. 1 through March 14, with blackout dates from Dec. 18 to Jan. 3 and Feb. 12 to 15.

scenes.text: Pastis opened in West Palm Beach this past October inside The Nora Hotel. The French brasserie started in New York’s Meatpacking District in nineteen ninety-nine, closed in twenty fourteen, returned in twenty nineteen, and now has its fifth location here.
scenes.caption: Pastis opened in West Palm Beach this past October inside The Nora Hotel. The French brasserie started in New York’s Meatpacking District in 1999, closed in 2014, returned in 2019, and now has its fifth location here.

scenes.text: Taste of West Palm Beach is coming to CityPlace this October. Related Ross announced it as a citywide culinary festival, so downtown gets another food stop on the calendar. If you hit CityPlace, open NEAR and see who else tasted there.
